# E-PM2 films-look-exif: owner camera test

The owner reports the pinned build working, with film output matching the fitted model and the film name in EXIF.

**physical camera; reported pass; complete report; reported hash.**

**Camera:** [Olympus PEN E-PM2](../cameras/epm2.md) · **Project:** [EPM2Mod](../projects/epm2mod.md)

**Firmware:** [E-PM2 firmware 1.6, build 1600](../firmware/epm2-1600.md) · **Mod build:** films-look-exif

**Provenance:** maintainer summary. **Reported:** 2026-11-20. **Test date:** 2026-11-20.

**Expected manifest SHA-256:** `af4bcb38df908c3d29b3ef028059a3142cbecc4b66737f7bb2cc2848d6a4bcf4`. This does not establish the installed package identity.

## Procedure and coverage

Flashed the logged build; developed a test RAW with Portra 400 and compared it with the model; checked EXIF in JPEG and ORF with and without a film, and in Natural; developed all 32 films. Emulator boot, update-path and hook checks passed before the flash.

- Portra 400 from the test RAW matches the model (ΔL* −0.2 to +0.1 in every lightness bin).
- A photo with a film records ArtFilter Off and the film's name in ImageDescription, in JPEG and ORF.
- All 32 films developed on this build.

## Limits and assumptions

- One owner and one camera; not reproduced by the Atlas.
- Filter Type and Add Effects are not tested with the film simulations.
- A recovery from a boot loop has not been recorded on this body.
